semantics: Per-layout shift, in native frames, between the parquet rows (state/action/state_valid_mask) and the video frames. The measured columns for video frame v are read from parquet row v + offset, clamped to the episode; timestamps and video stay on the video clock. Negative = proprio was recorded ahead of the pixels. Layouts absent here have offset 0.
evidence: Measured by aligning parquet observation.state with video motion at stride 1 over 60 episodes per layout; GM100_AgileX is the zero control (mode 0, MAD 0).
